label: Ericsson Radio Dot indoor small cell
description: Indoor 4G/5G SA small cell of the Radio Dot System, up to 4x4 MIMO and mid-band NR, powered and backhauled over the single Ethernet cable (PoE++) to an Indoor Radio Unit that serves up to eight Dots. Only that 1 Gigabit Ethernet port is modelled: the NR air interface is not a Wi-Fi radio, so no wireless port is declared.
